components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Used for main calls to action like 'Post a job' or 'Upload resume'.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #182025; color: #faf7f2; font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; padding: 12px 24px; border: none; border-radius: 9999px; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: oklch(0.25 0.02 250); transform: scale(1.05); box-shadow: 0 10px 20px rgba(24, 32, 37, 0.15); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Used for alternate/fallback options like 'Build my profile'.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: transparent; color: #182025; border: 1px solid rgba(24, 32, 37, 0.2); font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; padding: 12px 24px; border-radius: 9999px; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: oklch(0.93 0.02 95); border-color: rgba(24, 32, 37, 0.4); transform: scale(1.05); }

narrative.overview: The visual system of Fitboard rejects standard, over-saturated tech SaaS templates. It adopts an editorial aesthetic reminiscent of a physical catalog or newspaper directory. The interface uses a warm cream base, ink-black text and borders, spacious layouts, and a single electric-lime accent color to indicate matching metrics.
keyCharacteristics: Warm neutral backgrounds combined with high-contrast ink-black typography.
Thin borders for structure instead of heavy gradients or decorative shadows.
Generous white space and clear information hierarchy.
Perfect pill shapes for buttons, tags, and interactive elements.
Fluid micro-animations to enhance state changes and reveal sequences.

rules.name: The 10% Accent Rule
rules.body: Electric lime is used exclusively on <=10% of any given screen. Its rarity makes it an immediate anchor for candidate-job match metrics.

rules.name: The Italic Emphasis Rule
rules.body: Italic serif styling is used selectively within display typography to highlight key differentiators and key positioning words.

rules.name: The Elevation Response Rule
rules.body: Shadows never exist statically on basic layout items. They appear only on floating elements or key interactive cards responding to state changes (hover/focus).

dos: Do use Instrument Serif for hero headings, display statistics, and similarity scoring numbers.
Do ensure all body copy is high contrast against the warm cream background.
Do apply perfect pill shapes to all buttons and action tags.
Do respect the 10% Accent Rule when applying the Electric Lime color.
donts: Don't use border-left or border-right greater than 1px as a colored stripe.
Don't use gradient text under any circumstances.
Don't use glassmorphism blurs decoratively on standard page sections.
Don't use tiny uppercase kickers as standard eyebrows above every single header.
Don't use diagonal stripe backgrounds or decorative grid backgrounds.
Don't use card corners with a border-radius greater than 16px.
